In a fictional 2028, AI-driven productivity and high output coexist with mass white-collar unemployment and falling spending. Displacement compounds as companies reinvest payroll savings in AI, and the S&P 500 falls 38% from its peak.

## Social contract scores (draft)

| Promise | Score | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hard work pays | 1 | White-collar layoffs spread across professions, displaced workers bid down service wages and the labour share falls from 56% to 46% in four years. |
| Affordable essentials | 2 | Agents cut some fees and commissions, but households losing incomes struggle to meet existing mortgages, some with doubled debt-to-income ratios. |
| Reliable safety net | 1 | Stabilisers built for temporary job loss face structural displacement while receipts run 12% below the CBO baseline. |
| Responsive government | 2 | Washington debates a compute tax and public stake in AI, but partisan deadlock holds them up and faith in rescue declines. |
| Time for what matters | 2 | Employed professionals work harder out of fear and displaced ones take low-paid gig work. |
